logo.note: The textured raster and the SVG have different boxes: the textured one includes the streaks (+16px pad), the SVG is tight to the letters. letter_box_within_textured_frac locates the letters inside the textured image for alignment (e.g. a FLIP between the two).

quality_notes: reflective-tracksuit-screenshot.jpg is a JPEG phone screenshot of a product photo (photo strip ~1186x1212): its crops are served at <= 900px (products) / 560px (lookbook) and look soft when enlarged.
Embossed gothic hoodie stills come from 720x1280 HEVC phone video: max 720/800px wide, softer and noisier than the studio stills.

black-tracksuit-night.jpg is a phone flash photo with shadow noise; product version keeps the subject's colour and only darkens the surroundings, the lookbook/category/editorial versions carry the §5.4 grade.
Logo textured/streak renditions at 1800px are x1.49 Lanczos upscales of the ~1210px source crop (2000/2400 dropped: over 1.5x, DESIGN §3.4).
Detail crops: the sleeve label is small and dark in both sources (exposure lift applied); 1200px detail widths are dropped where they would exceed the 1.5x allowance.
sf-category-tops is the reflective tracksuit front, top crop (DESIGN §5.6); sf-category-new-arrivals is the graded IMG_4913 embossed close-up (same plate as sf-lookbook-embossed-hoodie, DESIGN §5.6).
Every still and product image is black-point clamped (luma <= 6 -> 0, smooth ramp to 12; DESIGN §5.3). This removes the lifted noise band at the bottom of the signature stills.

Lifestyle product views (heavyweight-zip-hoodie-black, wide-sweatpants-black, embossed-gothic-hoodie back-grey) carry the grade.sh editorial grade and edge burns that remove the third-party SUV/supercar; fixtures mark them kind=lifestyle (never the first gallery image).
sf-campaign-* keep the source grade (already graded at source) + the clamp; grade.sh's campaign mono mix is the film's treatment of the still, not applied to the editorial stills.
The campaign still had a small third-party logo on the balaclava; it was toned down by a diffusion fill (no other retouching).

sf-collection-hoodies (preview fixture only, not bundled) is the embossed gothic hoodie night back view (the back-grey plate, same grade and burns); its 900/1080 renditions are x1.41/x1.69 upscales of the 640 px video plate, by review request (r2 item 1).
